# netbox_device_type (Data Source)

Retrieves a single device type from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get device type by model name
data "netbox_device_type" "ex1" {
  model = "7210 SAS-Sx 10/100GE"
}

# Get device type by slug
data "netbox_device_type" "ex2" {
  slug = "7210-sas-sx-10-100GE"
}

# Get device type by manufacturer and part number information
data "netbox_device_type" "ex3" {
  manufacturer = "Nokia"
  part_number  = "3HE11597AARB01"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `manufacturer` (String) The manufacturer of the device type.
- `model` (String) The model of the device type.
- `part_number` (String) The part number of the device type.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the device type.
- `subdevice_role` (String) The subdevice role of the device type.

### Read-Only

- `airflow` (String) The airflow of the device type.
- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the device type.
- `console_port_template_count` (Number) The number of console port template objects that refer to the device type.
- `console_server_port_template_count` (Number) The number of console server port template objects that refer to the device type.
- `cooling_intake_template_count` (Number) The number of cooling intake template objects that refer to the device type.
- `cooling_method` (String) The cooling method of the device type.
- `cooling_outflow_template_count` (Number) The number of cooling outflow template objects that refer to the device type.
- `created` (String) When the device type was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the device type, as a map of field name to value.
- `default_platform_id` (Number) The ID of the default platform associated with the device type.
- `description` (String) A description of the device type.
- `device_bay_template_count` (Number) The number of device bay template objects that refer to the device type.
- `device_count` (Number) The number of device objects that refer to the device type.
- `end_of_life` (String) The end of life of the device type.
- `exclude_from_utilization` (Boolean) The exclude from utilization of the device type.
- `front_image` (String) The front image of the device type.
- `front_port_template_count` (Number) The number of front port template objects that refer to the device type.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `interface_template_count` (Number) The number of interface template objects that refer to the device type.
- `inventory_item_template_count` (Number) The number of inventory item template objects that refer to the device type.
- `is_full_depth` (Boolean) Whether the device type is full depth.
- `last_updated` (String) When the device type was last changed.
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) The ID of the manufacturer associated with the device type.
- `module_bay_template_count` (Number) The number of module bay template objects that refer to the device type.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the device type.
- `power_outlet_template_count` (Number) The number of power outlet template objects that refer to the device type.
- `power_port_template_count` (Number) The number of power port template objects that refer to the device type.
- `rear_image` (String) The rear image of the device type.
- `rear_port_template_count` (Number) The number of rear port template objects that refer to the device type.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.

- `weight_unit` (String) The weight unit of the device type.
